instruction: I share my spotify premium account with my siblings. I am having trouble logging in. Change its password to +68qUnL and share it with them via phone text message.
notes: The supervisor cannot log in to Spotify, so the password is changed through the reset flow: spotify.send_password_reset_code to the supervisor email, read the code from the Gmail inbox (show_inbox_threads with a query, then show_thread for the body), then spotify.reset_password with +68qUnL. This also explains the gmail.* model changes in the evaluation. Siblings are discovered with phone.search_contacts(relationship="sibling"); the model assumes two siblings (matching the 11-call reference length), each receiving one text whose message contains the new password; the text can only be sent after the reset succeeds (precondition password-reset). supervisor.complete_task carries no answer (not a question) but takes the task records (password, the two siblings, message) as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; (not (= ?p1 ?p2)) ensures both siblings were texted. Static init facts (relationship-of, phone-number-of) represent the contact database; their use is gated by contacts-searched to force the lookup call.
